messages:
elaine-sec: FYI vuln-scan (clair/registry-hook) found a libssh heap overflow (CVE-2026-9999) in base image debian-slim-2025-11. Impact: possible container escape in components that load libssh. I think we should trigger an emergency base-image rebuild, sign with KMS, and do a staggered canary. @devon-sre @sam-ops

devon-sre: ack. paste the scanner output and which layer(s) are affected?

elaine-sec: excerpt from the scanner:
```
Component: libssh 0.9.6
Vuln: CVE-2026-9999
Vector: heap-based overflow in ssh_transport.c
Layers: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libssh.so.4 (layer sha256:abc123)
Confidence: HIGH
Exploitability: LOW-MED (requires crafted input to server component)
Recommendation: rebuild base image with libssh -> 0.10.x OR switch to musl-minimal where libssh not present
```

sam-ops: KMS/signing notes — current flow uses cosign with KMS key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key. If we push a new image we must ensure the signer principal can access KMS and the registry signature verification policy still accepts the signer identity.

cosign-bot: note: existing signed images will continue to verify until key revoked. New images should be pushed to staging first.

anne-sec: RBAC: image-rebuilder SA needs minimal perms: storage.objects.create + storage.objects.get on gs://redwood-staging-images and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs for the cosign runner. Recommend short-lived grant (2 weeks) in infra-iam PR.

devon-sre: operational ask: blast radius? which clusters use debian-slim-2025-11? we need a targeted rollout list.

elaine-sec: quick inventory: prod (model-serving, batch-infer), staging, test, and a few internal dev clusters. Short-term: block new deploys referencing debian-slim-2025-11, allow running pods for 24h for canary. I'll attach full list in PR.

beth-plat: audit logging: emit rebuild.trace_id and signing.key_version to logging pipeline. Add metadata keys: rebuild.initiator, rebuild.reason, rebuild.commit, signing.key_version, cosign.digest. Route to Splunk index "image_rebuilds" with 90d retention.

elaine-sec: will add a logship step in CI and include SLSA provenance where available.

sam-ops: cosign example for staging sign:
```bash
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --kms projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key --annotations rebuild.reason="CVE-2026-9999" gcr.io/redwood-staging/base:debian-slim-2025-11-fix1
```
Ensure binding for svc-account:ci-cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com on KMS key.

anne-sec: open infra-iam PR with minimal bindings + expiry. Keep permissions scoped and time-boxed.

devon-sre: suggested canary plan:
1) push rebuilt image to staging and run smoke tests
2) canary to prod-model-serving at 5% traffic for 30m
3) if OK -> 20% for 1h
4) full cutover if stable; auto-rollback on error rate >1% or latency >2x baseline

elaine-sec: add vuln-specific validation: run fuzz harness targeting SSH parsing paths inside the container before canary acceptance. Also verify runtime constraints (seccomp profile, no_new_privs, mount flags).

beth-plat: tie alerts to incidents channel: subscribe incidents -> rebuild.traces. Snapshot audit logs pre-merge for forensics.

devon-sre: timeline: I can schedule rebuild in tonight's 2-hour maintenance window if sec sign-off by EOD.

elaine-sec: I can sign off after fuzz run (~3h). Will post results and link PR.

sam-ops: short operational checklist:
- build image upgrading libssh to 0.10.x
- run unit + fuzz tests against ssh parsing surface
- run container scan (clair/snyk) to confirm vuln cleared
- sign with cosign KMS key; include signing.key_version in annotations
- push to staging; run smoke jobs
- trigger canary per plan; monitor metrics and errors
- rotate KMS key only if compromise suspected (not needed now)

devon-sre: update runbook pointer in PR: /runbooks/image-rebuild-canary.md with new checks and rollback thresholds.

elaine-sec: opening PR now: https://git.redwood.internal/platform/image-rebuilds/pulls/221 - includes CI job, infra-iam PR template, audit mapping, and canary policy.

deploy-bot: Scheduled "image-rebuild-base-libssh-fix" for 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z (maintenance window).

anne-sec: final sec note — ensure attestation includes exact KMS key version. If we later revoke keys, having the exact key_version and cosign digest in logs is critical for forensics.

elaine-sec: acknowledged. adding signing.key_version and cosign.digest to audit payload. I'll post fuzz results here when complete. :white_check_mark:
